templates.source: 2N wiki — Starting manual for integration with 2N IP Intercoms: https://wiki.2n.com/faqint/en/startovaci-manual-pro-integraci-s-2n-ip-interkomy-104862445.html

notes: 2N IP intercoms expose per-codec RTSP paths, not a main/sub hierarchy. Official docs list four paths: / (uses configured profile), /h264_stream (H.264), /mpeg4_stream (MPEG-4), /mjpeg_stream (MJPEG). No sub-stream or channel-indexed URL is documented. RTSP is limited to 4 parallel connections. An Enhanced Video licence (Part No. 9137906) is required to enable streaming on older firmware; newer Helios models include it. 2N is now an Axis subsidiary. Port 554 is the RTSP default; docs do not specify a non-standard port.
